newsitem.title: USA: Basin Electric 550 MW Wyo. unit off line Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Basin Electric 550 MW Wyo. unit off line Wednesday.

text.p: Basin Electric Power Cooperative said it expects a 550 megawatt coal fired unit 3 at its Laramie River Station in Wyoming to be taken off line Wednesday for maintenance and restart output Sunday.
"We are planning a scheduled outage for later today, it should be back on line Sunday morning," Basin Electric spokesman Daryl Hill said Wednesday.
The plant's other two 550 megawatt units continue to operate normally, the spokesman said.
Basin Electric, headquartered in Bismarck, N.D., is the operator of the plant and holds a 42.27 percent ownership stake.
Five other Midwest public utilities co-own the plant.
